title: Multiplet Recombination and the CFT Distance Conjecture
summary: Motivated by quantum gravity and the CFT Distance Conjecture, we study infinite-distance limits in four-dimensional ${\cal N}=2$ superconformal field theories with higher-dimensional conformal manifolds and their AdS duals. We focus on partial decoupling limits where a gauge sector becomes weakly coupled while an interacting sector persists. We analyse the structure of towers of states emerging in these limits.
